title: 第一卷 第26章 修炼不努力，人皇幡里做兄弟！
novel_title: 开局自曝系统，家族助我娶妻成仙！
content_zh:
当三生阁众长老复活的那一刻，安祈雪姐妹的心里，就已经做出了决定。

    死而复生，手段通天！

    这既是姜无痕在向她们证明姜家的实力，又是赐予她们额外的恩惠。

    威逼利诱，向来是谈判的重要手段。

    “小女子安祈雪，愿携小妹安兮兮……侍奉恩公左右！”

    安祈雪下跪行礼，看向姜无痕的眼神中，带着几分敬畏。

    “姐姐……”

    安兮兮也跟着跪下，低着头，满脸娇羞。

    “善！”

    姜无痕满意点头，上前将这对姐妹花扶起，并顺势将二人一左一右抱在怀中。

    一时间，香玉满怀！

    安兮兮虽显稚嫩，身子却软绵绵的，带着少女独有的青春触感。

    安祈雪则是珠圆玉润，柔软饱满的手感，更是让人爱不释手。

    反观二女，满脸羞涩，同时心生敬畏，娇躯微微颤抖，不敢抬头与姜无痕对视。

    姜无痕不必在意这些，现在彼此了解的还不够，她们出身下界，对上位者心存敬畏是在所难免的。

    待到日后深入了解几次就好了！

    “雪姨，向家族传讯，事情一切顺利，让他们好好准备……迎接新的帝子妃！”

    姜无痕淡然吩咐道。

    “是，帝子！”

    雪姨领命，走出了大殿。

    不远处，三生阁的几位长老面面相觑，表情茫然。

    他们记得自己已经死了，却又不知为何……突然复活。

    并且复活之后，他们感觉自己变强了！

    几位洞天境的长老，莫名其妙的晋升化龙境。而原本是化龙境第七重的老妪，直接达到化龙境巅峰，眼看就要破境飞升！

    就连寿命，都至少增加了百年！

    不过，结果好像没变，圣主和圣女还是要被人给带走……

    “圣主……”

    老妪强忍着心中恐惧，轻声唤道。

    安祈雪娇躯一颤，轻咬粉唇，欲言又止。

    姜无痕见状，并未责怪她们，温柔笑道：“爱妃可还有话，要跟下属交代？”

    “可以吗？”

    安祈雪怯生生的开口。

    ‘爱妃’二字，让她的脸色越发红润。

    姜无痕点头，轻笑道：“当然可以！”

    “雪姨赐下的丹药，不仅让他们起死回生，对他们而言，更是一场造化。不出意外的话，他们此生都能突破到阴阳境……哦，也就是你们所说的‘神明’。”

    “你若想将三生阁的道统搬到上界，可以带着你的门人一块儿走。如果选择将三生阁继续留在创生莲华界，我会让人动用些手段，补全这方小世界的些许法则，提升世界等级……”
content_en:
The moment the elders of Sansheng Pavilion were resurrected, sister An Qixue had already made a decision in her heart.

    Resurrected from the dead, his methods reach the sky!

    This was not only Jiang Wuhen proving the strength of the Jiang family to them, but also giving them extra favors.

    Coercion and inducement have always been an important means of negotiation.

    "My little girl An Qixue, I would like to bring my little sister An Xixi... to serve my benefactor!"

    An Qixue knelt down and saluted, looking at Jiang Wuhen with a bit of awe in her eyes.

    "Sister..."

    An Xixi also knelt down, her head lowered, her face full of shyness.

    "Good!"

    Jiang Wuhen nodded with satisfaction, stepped forward to help the sisters up, and held them in his arms, one on the left and the other on the right.

    For a moment, my arms were full of fragrant jade!

    Although An Xixi looked immature, her body was soft and soft, with the youthful touch unique to a girl.

    An Qixue is round and round, with a soft and full feel that makes people fall in love with it.

    On the other hand, the two girls were shy and awe-stricken at the same time. Their delicate bodies were trembling slightly, and they did not dare to raise their heads and look at Jiang Wuhen.

    Jiang Wuhen didn't need to care about this. They didn't know each other well enough now. They were born in the lower world, so it was inevitable for them to be in awe of those above them.

    It will be nice to learn more about it a few times in the future!

    "Aunt Xue, send word to the family that everything is going well and let them prepare well... to welcome the new emperor's concubine!"

    Jiang Wuhen ordered calmly.

    "Yes, Emperor's son!"

    Aunt Xue took the order and walked out of the hall.

    Not far away, several elders of Sansheng Pavilion looked at each other with blank expressions.

    They remember that they were dead, but somehow... they suddenly came back to life.

    And after being resurrected, they felt stronger!

    Several elders from the Cave Heaven Realm were inexplicably promoted to the Dragon Transformation Realm. And the old woman who was originally at the seventh level of the Dragon Transformation Realm has directly reached the peak of the Dragon Transformation Realm and is about to break through and ascend!

    Even the life span has been increased by at least a hundred years!

    However, the result seems to have not changed, the Holy Lord and the Holy Lady will still be taken away...

    "Holy Lord..."

    The old woman suppressed the fear in her heart and called softly.

    An Qixue's delicate body trembled, she bit her pink lips and stopped talking.

    Jiang Wuhen saw this and did not blame them. He smiled softly and said, "My beloved, do you have anything else to tell your subordinates?"

    "Is that okay?"

    An Qixue spoke timidly.

    The word "beloved concubine" made her face become more and more rosy.

    Jiang Wuhen nodded and chuckled: "Of course!"

    "The elixir given by Aunt Xue not only brings them back to life, but is also a blessing for them. If nothing else happens, they will be able to break through to the Yin and Yang realm in this life... Oh, they are what you call 'gods'."

    "If you want to move Sansheng Pavilion's orthodoxy to the upper realm, you can take your disciples with you. If you choose to keep Sansheng Pavilion in the Lotus Realm of Creation, I will have people use some means to complete some of the laws of this small world and improve the world level..."
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 26 If you don’t work hard in cultivation, you will be brothers in the Human Emperor Banner!
